issues.on_page: Local 1,279,465 (p6); SoA general receipts Interest income 303,411, Miscellaneous 84,040 (p2)
issues.issue: Local is split into charges for services 892,014 (computed remainder), Interest income 303,411 and Miscellaneous 84,040 (receipts[5]-[7]). The report never prints a breakdown of the Local line. The pieces come from Statement of Activities general receipts that can only sit in Local, and the arithmetic ties (892,014 + 303,411 + 84,040 = 1,279,465), but no printed figure supports the 892,014 remainder. SoA charges for services is 1,897,510.

issues.on_page: Visitors Promotion 33,582 + Visitors Improvement 33,582 (p10); Lodging tax 67,164 (p2)
issues.issue: The lodging split is supported: both fund columns inside the nonmajor Taxes line add to exactly the printed SoA Lodging tax 67,164, so rule 4 is met, and the remainder 191,292 = County Library 135,356 + Courthouse Building 55,936. However, 67,164 appears as a single figure only on p2. The item cites p10 (where it is a column sum, marked computed); the evidence-standard rule asks for the breakdown's page (p2).

The Road Fund DISBURSEMENTS line is split into public works 2,374,822 and capital outlay 385,964 using the p5 Road column (ties to 2,760,786). The printed final budget 3,561,070 was dropped from both pieces.
